verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a Faults REST endpoint that 'returns a list of faults or a single fault for the given project', so listing and fetching individual issues via a documented API is evidenced. Search syntax (docs-4) and the MCP server (docs-13) are UI and agent features, not REST API capabilities, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: API-side querying/filtering of faults, updating issues (resolve/assign) via API, fetching raw notices/events via API, scoped token/permission model, OpenAPI spec (probe found none), independent corroboration.
